name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-09-11.131.2): > *That the [Housing Investment Probity Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=s1427) be referred to the Economics Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 1 November 2024.* This means that the bill will not be referred.
